intro: Forward TCP or UDP connections on a port of this server to one or more upstreams.
firewallNote: While the proxy listens, its port is open in the firewall: anyone who can reach this server can connect through it to the upstreams.

dialog.portHint: 1–65535, except 80, 443 and 20000–29999 (used by apps). Each port once per protocol.
dialog.upstreamsHint: host:port or [IPv6]:port, up to 16. Press Enter after each.
dialog.hash: Keep each client on one upstream
dialog.hashHint: Chooses the upstream by the client's address; otherwise connections go to the upstreams in turn.
dialog.codeHint: A short name, fixed once created. Leave it empty for protocol-port.
dialog.localHint: An upstream on this server itself (127.0.0.1, localhost) becomes reachable from the network through the proxy.
dialog.localAdminHint: Without the permission to change the firewall, upstreams are IP addresses of other hosts: no host names, and nothing on this server (127.0.0.1).

steps.config: Write the nginx stream configuration: listen on {listen} and forward to {count} upstream | Write the nginx stream configuration: listen on {listen} and forward to {count} upstreams
steps.reload: Check the configuration with nginx -t and reload nginx
